name: telemetry_dropout__odometry
regression: Stale telemetry on one topic, told apart from transport loss because the host's other periodic topic is alive.
initial_conditions: Synthetic GO2 + HELIX run (6.5 s): /nav/cmd_vel at 20 Hz commands 0 m/s, then 0.15 m/s from t=2 s; HELIX hold published at 10 Hz, never asserted; odometry and lowstate at 20 Hz from the robot host, whose clock is 1.734 s ahead of the payload.
injected_fault: Odometry is silent for 1.5 s from t=3.0 s; lowstate from the same host keeps arriving.
